name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast with no glow. This guarantees visibility for users with low vision or screen glare while keeping the design clean. The trade-off is a slightly thicker ring, but it’s worth it—users must never guess where focus is.

name: Reader
text: A 4px ring at 7:1 contrast still fails on patterned or high-contrast backgrounds—users with low vision or screen glare will lose the ring. A 2px ring with 20% inner glow survives those backgrounds but risks disappearing on low-contrast patterned ones. Settle it with a toggle: let users pick solid or glow, tested on 10 patterned backgrounds at 3 contrast levels.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt a 2px focus ring with a 20% inner glow at 4.5:1 contrast. This survives patterned backgrounds and glare without disappearing, which matters most for users with low vision. The trade-off is a slightly softer ring on solid backgrounds, but visibility on complex surfaces is non-negotiable.
[dispatched 2 workers: worker-2618, worker-5971 — done, dissolved]

name: Reader
text: A 2px ring with 20% inner glow at 4.5:1 contrast still risks vanishing on low-contrast patterned backgrounds—users with low vision or glare will lose focus. Settle it with a toggle between solid 7:1 and glow 4.5:1 rings, tested on real patterned backgrounds.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt a user-toggleable focus ring system: solid 4px at 7:1 contrast for clean backgrounds, and 2px with 20% inner glow at 4.5:1 contrast for patterned/high-glare surfaces. Owner: Ramp to implement the toggle and Reader to verify with real patterned backgrounds.
